method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill, from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; rules in the regulation's terms, exported seat questions derived from them, one duty as a regulative rule; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: 106 CMR 704.000 as posted on Mass.gov on 2026-10-24 (PDF pages dated 5/10/24), with the TAFDC Table of Need and Payment Standards 704.410-704.420 posted by the Department (retrieved 2026-10-24), as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/
license: Apache-2.0 for the L4; the regulation text may be copied and used for any purpose under the Mass.gov Terms of Use (see ../../SOURCE-LICENSE.md)

checks.l4: stable l4 of VS Code extension legalese.l4-vscode 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset
checks.command: l4 run tafdc-cases.l4 ; l4 run tafdc.l4
checks.result: 22 assertions satisfied, 0 errors, 0 warnings; one #TRACE breached as its expect comment says
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read.

scope: TAFDC for one family in one month with one earner: the Need and Payment Standards (704.410, 704.420, posted figures, September 2026 clothing allowance), the income test at application (704.260 with 704.270, 704.275, 704.280), the grant (704.500(A) with 704.281), the dependent care deduction (704.275), and the duty to report a change in deemed income within ten days (704.235(B)(1)). Out: EAEDC, assets and transfers, deeming amounts, lump sums, verification, several earners. The statute (M.G.L. c. 118) is not deposited.
seat: the applicant for, or client of, TAFDC (parent or caretaker)
